summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-base preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated loader (mangled `_0x...` identifiers, string-indirection maps) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, chmods it executable in a temp directory, and uses it to execute the sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line obfuscated blob prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs` with a shuffled constant array and rotator function `WV8StW`. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the sibling payload is executed under a freshly-fetched non-Node runtime so that Node-based install-time scanners do not see the code that actually runs. The advertised purpose of the package is a Babel preset (`index.js` is a 30-line preset factory); nothing about a Babel preset requires fetching Bun or executing a 728KB opaque payload at install. The purpose mismatch, install-time execution of obfuscated code under an alien runtime, and shape of the loader are consistent with a compromised or hijacked publish of this scoped package. Installing this version causes arbitrary code execution on the installer host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
